replies.author: DonaldMyTrump
replies.body:
Hello,
You don't actually have the right to claim the footage as your own. The only people who can do that are mojang or Matoma, as they produced the content featured and video itself (being in a video or picture that is taken in an area deemed public doesn't give you a right to claim it). It breaks no avicus rules by itself. On the other hand the topic can be considered a flame war or an attempt to incite a flame war. We will look into the matter, discuss it and consider your request.
Sincerely, Zaccc

replies.author: JDKL
replies.body:
Hey there,
After reviewing this report, I have decided to Deny this report because this was Matoma's video content which therefore means he shouldn't need permission from you to upload it. In the future, I advise that you tell the opposite team if you're uncomfortable with the scrim being recorded but you can't force them to. 
 The thread seems to be calming down however, staff will look at it oftenly to see if any further flame-wars are starting. If so, we will decide about what we should with it (potentially locking it).
Regards,
Nitro - Avicus Moderator
